about: Test vectors of the cine rendering (docs/02-colour-pipeline.md, C12), made by training/cine/make_vectors.py from the model alone. x: scene-linear AWG4. rec709, p3, rec2020: display-linear RGB of that primaries (1.0 = SDR white). inverse709: the reference inverse of rec709 (scene AWG4); roundtrip709: the forward of inverse709; reachable709: the Rec.709 colour has a pre-image (false: the nearest reachable colour was used). A scene triple of the inverse is one pre-image among possibly several: compare display colours.
